title: Recording: Beautiful Boys, Dear Yoko by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

The eighth recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 15 August 1980.

Two tracks were worked on, both of which were included on the album: Ono’s song ‘Beautiful Boys’, followed by Lennon’s ‘Dear Yoko’.

Here’s something that I’m not proud of… I was so f*****g hungover and sick that day that I didn’t show up at the studio. I called, but I didn’t play on it. I was so f****d up that I couldn’t get to the studio. This is part of who I was at the time. That was one of the very few times in all the years, even when I was out of control, that I ever did something like that and of course I did it on a Lennon record.
Earl Slick, Double Fantasy guitarist
Starting Over, Ken Sharp
